SPECIFICATION FOR COUPLINGS FOR 
DISPOSAL OF SEWAGE WATER FOR INLAND VESSELS 

PART 1 FLANGE COUPLING 



1. Scope — Lays down the requirements for flange couplings to connect storage containers to the 
piping for the disposal of sewage water for inland vessels. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 The dimensions of the couplings shall be as given in Fig. 1 . 

Note — The flange is designed for tubes of internal diameter up to 100 mm.

2.3 The connection of the flanges shall be made with bolts of M 16 and of appropriate length. 

3. Material — The parts of couplings shall be manufactured from steel or other equivalent material, 

4. General Requirements 

4.1 The limit deviations of the dimensions and the surface roughness of couplings shall meet all 
requirements and the necessity of ensuring leak-proof joints. 

4.2 The conventional pressure for flange coupling shall be 0"6 MPa ( 6 kgf/cm^ ). 

5. Designation — The flange couplings shall be designated by the following: 

a) Name of the coupling, 

b) Number of standard, and 

c) Group of the coupling ( Bx for flange couplings for Sewage water ). 

Example: 

A flange coupling conforming to this shall be designated as follows: 
Flange Coupling IS : 12115 ( Part 1 ) - ^i 

6. Marking — The couplings shall be marked with manufacturer's name and designation. 
6.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard gives the requirements for couplings for disposal of sewage water used for inland 
vessels. The type of coupling is chosen depending upon the use of vessels and the system of 
polluted water transfer and treatment adopted In its operational area. 

This standard is being issued in the following four parts : 

Part 1 Flange coupling; 

Part 2 Quick-release coupling; 

Part 3 Adapter — Flange/end piece; and 

Part 4 Adapter — Flange/bush, 

Vessels of 'river/sea' type are equipped with fixed flange coupling as given in this part of the 
standard. 

Notwithstanding what is stated in this standard, the rules and requirement laid down by 
Classification Societies and Statutory Authorities in all respects shall apply. 

This standard is based on ISO 7608-1 985 Shipbuilding-inland navigation-couplings for disposal 
of oily mixture and sewage water issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 
The ISO standard classifies the couplings for sewage water under Group B and further sub-classifies 
the flange couplings as Type I. The same method of classification is used in this standard for the 
sake of uniformity.
